protocol.selection: Fixed factors and rules before scenario inference; no controller results used
protocol.scaling_reference: Unchanged Stage6/7 common Netflix-training multiplier; all factors multiply that study workload

mixed_daily.rule: factor[(source_index//96)%3], same absolute-index rule across partitions

rapid_real_day.training_selector: Maximum sum of absolute successive original-load changes in a contiguous 96-slot training-scored window, earliest start on ties
rapid_real_day.validation_selector: First full 96-slot validation window with the training-selected start clock time; no validation magnitude selection

protocol.inference: Frozen component weights/transforms, vectorized diagnostic calls; singleton adapter checks at measured/domain/threshold anchors, stratified scenario samples, and all near-threshold inputs; disclose numeric profile differences
protocol.grid: Diagnostic loads only, never invented workload samples: log/linear grid plus all analytic ReLU breakpoints and threshold roots
protocol.physical_validity: Declared interpolation is not certification; no formal acceptable error or false-safe tolerance approved; high scenarios exploratory only
